message: The other day, I found myself reminiscing about those snowy days when my family would gather around in our cozy living room, hot cocoa in hand, ready for whatever the weather brought our way. It struck me how preparing for unexpected events can feel a bit like planning for a family game night — just a little organization can turn the unknown into a chance for togetherness. I recently came across a handy guide that helps you put together an emergency kit, making it a fun little project to tackle with the grandkids. Who knew preparedness could spark such warmth? What cozy traditions do you have in your family?
